title: rosa rugosa subsp. coruscans
intro: Rosa rugosa subsp. coruscans, commonly known as Japanese beach rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa rugosa species, a type of flowering shrub native to East Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Rosa rugosa subsp. coruscans include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
